templates.explanation:
Using BODMAS — Brackets first, then M and D left to right, then Addition.
= [A] + [B] × ([C] - [D]) ÷ [E]
= [A] + [B] × [C-D] ÷ [E]
= [A] + [B*(C-D)] ÷ [E]
= [A] + [B*(C-D)/E]
= [RESULT]

Rule: B → M and D (left to right) → A

Using BODMAS — Both brackets first, then Multiplication.
= ([A] + [B]) × ([C] - [D])
= [A+B] × [C-D]
= [RESULT]

Rule: Solve both bracket expressions first, then multiply the results.

constraints: A * B + C * D - E / F > 0
templates.calculation: A * B + C * D - E / F
templates.explanation:
Using BODMAS — All M and D first (left to right), then A and S left to right.
= [A] × [B] + [C] × [D] - [E] ÷ [F]
= [A*B] + [C*D] - [E/F]
= [A*B+C*D] - [E/F]
= [RESULT]

Rule: Complete all M and D operations before A and S.

Using BODMAS — Brackets and Multiplication first, then A and S left to right.
= [A] + [B] × [C] - ([D] + [E])
= [A] + [B*C] - [D+E]
= [A+B*C] - [D+E]
= [RESULT]

Rule: Bracket and M are resolved first, then left to right for A and S.

Using BODMAS — Bracket first, then D and M, then Addition.
= [A] ÷ ([B] - [C]) + [D] × [E]
= [A] ÷ [B-C] + [D] × [E]
= [A/(B-C)] + [D*E]
= [RESULT]

Rule: B → D and M → A

Using BODMAS — Inside bracket: M before A. Then Division outside.
= ([A] + [B] × [C]) ÷ [D]
= ([A] + [B*C]) ÷ [D]
= [A+B*C] ÷ [D]
= [RESULT]

Rule: Even inside brackets, BODMAS applies — M before A.

Using BODMAS — Brackets first, then both Multiplications, then Subtraction.
= [A] × [B] - [C] × ([D] - [E])
= [A] × [B] - [C] × [D-E]
= [A*B] - [C*(D-E)]
= [RESULT]

Rule: B → M → S

Using BODMAS — Inside bracket: D before S. Then Multiplication outside. Then Addition.
= [A] + ([B] ÷ [C] - [D]) × [E]
= [A] + ([B/C] - [D]) × [E]
= [A] + [B/C-D] × [E]
= [A] + [(B/C-D)*E]
= [RESULT]

Rule: Inside brackets — D before S. Then B → M → A.

Using BODMAS — Both brackets first (inside each: M before S), then Subtraction.
= [A] × ([B] + [C]) - ([D] × [E] - [F])
= [A] × [B+C] - ([D*E] - [F])
= [A*(B+C)] - [D*E-F]
= [RESULT]

Rule: Resolve all brackets first — inside each bracket follow BODMAS too.

constraints: A / B + C * D - (E - F / G) > 0
templates.calculation: A / B + C * D - (E - F / G)
templates.explanation:
Using BODMAS — Bracket first (D inside before S), then D and M outside, then A and S left to right.
= [A] ÷ [B] + [C] × [D] - ([E] - [F] ÷ [G])
= [A/B] + [C*D] - ([E] - [F/G])
= [A/B] + [C*D] - [E-F/G]
= [RESULT]

Rule: Full BODMAS — B → D/M → A/S (all left to right at each level).
